current_arc: The Airport Reunion & The Unspoken Past

history.title: 6 വർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് ശേഷം (After 6 Long Years)
history.summary: Reenu and Sachin's best friend Amal wait anxiously at Cochin International Airport (CIAL) International Arrivals. Flight BA-354 arrives from London. Reenu spots Sachin pulling his silver luggage trolley. Their eyes lock across the crowd, dissolving 6 years of waiting. Sachin smiles radiantly, Amal cheers wildly over the railing, and Sachin and Reenu rush to embrace each other.
history.cliffhanger: As they embrace, the narrator reveals that unspoken truths and secrets accumulated over the 6-year distance are waiting to unfold.

history.title: മറച്ചുവെച്ച നിമിഷങ്ങൾ (Hidden Moments) (Hidden Moments)
history.summary: Directly continuing from the emotional embrace at Cochin Airport, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal walk to the parking lot. While placing the luggage in the car, Reenu notices a mysterious velvet ring box in Sachin's backpack. Suddenly, Sachin receives an anxious call from a UK number, igniting a silent tension between the reunited lovers.
history.cliffhanger: As Sachin nervously hides his phone and makes an excuse, Reenu looks out of the car window, wondering if the man who returned from London is still the same Sachin she loved.

history.title: മൗനത്തിന്റെ ദൂരം (The Distance of Silence)
history.summary: Directly continuing from the tension at the airport parking lot, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal drive through the rain-slicked streets of Kochi. Reenu is troubled by the mysterious UK phone call and the velvet box she spotted in Sachin's bag. As Amal tries to break the heavy silence with his typical humor, Sachin's nervous behavior and another silent phone notification push Reenu to her emotional limit, threatening to turn their long-awaited reunion into a heartbreaking distance.
history.cliffhanger: When Sachin tries to reach for Reenu's hand to comfort her, she quietly pulls away, leaving a silent, painful void between them as the car drives into the Kochi night.
